scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin main --tags

scripts-info.compile: Build a standalone binary in the current directory
scripts-info.release:patch: Bump patch version (0.1.0 → 0.1.1), tag, and push to trigger GitHub release
scripts-info.release:minor: Bump minor version (0.1.0 → 0.2.0), tag, and push to trigger GitHub release
scripts-info.release:major: Bump major version (0.1.0 → 1.0.0), tag, and push to trigger GitHub release
